gold_row.question: Welche Spannung hat Sensor 3.0 am 2004-02-28 um 01:50:16 gemessen?
gold_row.gold_answer: Dazu liegen mir keine Daten vor.
gold_row.gold_cypher:
MATCH (s:Sensor {mote_id: 3})-[:GENERATED]->(m:Measurement)
WHERE m.time STARTS WITH "2004-02-28T01:50:16"
RETURN m.time AS time, m.voltage AS value
ORDER BY m.time ASC
LIMIT 1
